title: Gateway replay identity
responsibility: Hashes the serialized gateway request for replay lookup.

inputs.name: gatewayReplay.request
inputs.description: Carries `model`, literal `stream: true`, `input`, `tools`, and optional `instructions` for serialization. It is hashed without normalization, so JSON.stringify output, including property order and nested values, determines the identity.

outputs.name: gatewayReplay
outputs.description: The lowercase 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 digest of the JSON.stringify(request) string. It changes when that serialized string changes; the function does not normalize the request or mutate replay state.

errors.name: TypeError
errors.description: JSON.stringify throws for cyclic request data or a BigInt nested in the request, and gatewayReplay does not catch the error.
